---
title: "Title `r 1 + 1`"
custom-key: "Custom `{r} 2 + 3`"
nested:
  inner: "Nested `r 3 * 3`"
engine: knitr
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - '<h1 class="title">Title 2</h1>'
          - '<div id="custom-key">\s*<p>Custom 5</p>'
          - '<div id="nested-inner">\s*<p>Nested 9</p>'
        - []
---

Inline R expressions in YAML front matter are evaluated by knitr, and the evaluated values must reach pandoc: the standard `title`, a custom top-level key, and a nested key with no project-level counterpart.
